requester.say: Tap here and photograph the slip flat, in good light. Petti straightens it, cleans it up and reads it – a blurred or cut-off picture is refused with the reason. A PDF or e-receipt works too.
No receipt at all (a taxi, a street seller)? Tap here and say why. Finance decides whether it can be paid without one.

No receipt at all? Tap here and say why. Finance decides whether it can be paid without one.

finance.say: Paying out – here or on a request under “Pay out from petty cash” – you now choose the proof: “Proof required” (the default) or “No proof possible” with the reason.
Everything paid without proof is listed here, with the reason and who decided. The GM and the MD see the same list.

approver.say: Money finance paid out without a receipt (a taxi, a street seller, a tip), with the reason, who decided, and where the spender says it went. For information – nothing to approve.

managing_director.say: Money finance paid out without a receipt, with the reason and who decided. For information – nothing to approve. It is also in the month-end pack.
